idea: Build a complete native Android application called Smart Expense Tracker. Package name: com.sikorokoro44.expensetracker. Create a polished, production-quality personal finance tracker that works completely offline. Features: record income and expenses; create, edit and delete transactions; categorize transactions; save data persistently in a local database; show daily weekly and monthly summaries; display income, expenses and remaining balance; support search filtering and sorting; allow users to set monthly budgets by category; show spending charts and budget warnings; export transactions to CSV; support decimal amounts and multiple currencies including SZL, ZAR and USD; include PIN-based app locking; provide a responsive interface with light and dark themes; validate all inputs and handle errors safely; never lose saved transactions when the app restarts; require no account, subscription or internet access for core functionality. Use the AI App Builder 20-agent system with dynamic task allocation and dependency management. Build the APK using GitHub Actions in the cloud. Verify the APK, package name, integrity and public download URL. Publish a release only after all required verification checks pass.
